statement_excerpts: Let $F_T$ be a face of the graph multiplihedron $\mathcal{J}(L(P))$ associated to an acyclic tubing $T$ of the line graph of the Hasse diagram of $P$. Then $F_T$ intersects the evaluation space, which is the intersection of all the cycle hyperplanes.
